title: Ordinary open restriction evaluation and its inverse mate
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite field extension, let $j:X\to Z$ be an open immersion of schemes, and let $o$ be any IntegralOpenReduction.Operations presentation of [def-sf-integral-open-operations], with its independent scheme and coefficient universes. For every $n\in\mathbf N$ there is a natural isomorphism from systemRestriction followed by level evaluation on $X$ to level evaluation on $Z$ followed by finiteRestriction at $n$. Under the specified ordinary system adjunction and finite localized adjunction, the inverse mate of its forward natural transformation is exactly extensionEvaluation.inv of that presentation. All operations in this assertion are ordinary functors on module sheaves.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; specialization of coherence proof steps 1--3 and 6

proof.text: The unit_evaluation identity in the open-slice presentation shows that the inverse mate of restrictionEvaluation.hom is extensionEvaluation.inv: apply the finite adjunction Hom equivalence, compose with the invertible restriction of extensionEvaluation.hom, and cancel.

The mate of transportEvaluation.inv between the two coefficient-equivalence adjunctions is invertible, because all factors in its unit/counit formula are invertible. Paste it with the first square. The horizontal-pasting law for mates makes the resulting right square invertible. Apply inverse mates and cancel the equivalence; expanding the pasted left square is exactly extensionEvaluation.inv.

proof_origin.place: Open-slice unit normalization, equivalence adjunctions, and the horizontal pasting law for ordinary mates; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Stacks 03DI--03DJ, 0941.

theorem compactSupportOpenOrdinaryMate
    {X Z : Scheme.{t}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ d : IntegralOpenReduction.systemRestriction l E j o ⋙
          coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n ≅
        coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Z n ⋙
          IntegralOpenReduction.finiteRestriction l E j o n,
      ((mateEquiv (IntegralOpenReduction.ordinarySystemAdjunction l E j o)
        ((o.finite n).toAdjunction.comp
          (SheafOfModules.localizedSystemAdjunction.{t+1, t, max u (t+1)}
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Z n)
            (IntegralOpenReduction.openObject j)))).symm
        (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ d.hom)).natTrans =
          (IntegralOpenReduction.extensionEvaluation l E j o n).inv
